text:
I've visited this clinic twice: for an Air Flow cleaning and two fillings. I was very impressed; everything was done quickly and efficiently. The doctor was attentive and the nurses were efficient and attentive.
I liked that, unlike other clinics, no one will push their services on you. If the doctor notices a problem, they'll point it out. That's it; no hassle. Whether you want it done or not, you've been informed and have the right to decide for yourself whether to have treatment here or elsewhere, now or later. Aggressive marketing always puts me off, but that's not the case here. The doctor's reputation speaks for itself, so they don't need to convince you of anything; their clients will come to them themselves. Isn't that a sign of professionalism?
I'll only come here for cleanings and subsequent oral health checkups 🤗
